<!-- Generated by web/docs/tools/generate-sdk-reference.py. Do not edit. -->

Public signatures and types from the TypeScript SDK, including resource helpers and model contracts.
Start with [Getting started with the SDK](/sdk/); see [Errors and recovery](/sdk/errors/) for connection lifetime, deadlines, and retries.

## hypervisor

```ts
export declare class Hypervisor extends Client {
    readonly networks: Networks;
    /** The MCP servers every VM runs, from settings and corp config. */
    readonly mcp: Mcp;
    readonly debug: Debug;
    readonly images: Images;
    readonly credentials: Credentials;
    readonly connections: Connections;
    constructor(url: string, token: string, options?: TransportOptions);
    info(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.HypervisorInfo>;
    list(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.ListResponse>;
    vm(selector: VmSelector): VM;
    create(options?: CreateOptions): Promise<VM>;
    managed(options?: ManagedCreateOptions): Promise<ManagedSession>;
    withManaged<T>(options: ManagedCreateOptions, work: (vm: VM, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
    log(options?: HostLogOptions): Promise<models.HostLogsResponse>;
    run(command: string, options?: RunOptions): Promise<models.ExecResponse>;
    purge(options?: CallOptions & {
        all?: boolean;
    }): Promise<models.PurgeResponse>;
    update(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.UpdateActionResponse>;
    restart(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.RestartResponse>;
}
```

    resume(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.ProvisionResponse>;

}

## managed

```ts
/** Finite ownership of one ephemeral VM; ordinary VM.close stays connection-only. */
export declare class ManagedSession {
    get ownership(): models.ManagedSessionOwnership | undefined;
    get vm(): VM;
    /** Aborts when the owner is cancelled, closes, or loses its lease. */
    get signal(): AbortSignal;
    /** Await the original close before returning the callback's result or failure. */
    run<T>(work: (vm: VM, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
    /** Join cleanup; a failed close is retried only by another explicit close call. */
    close(outcome?: models.ManagedSessionOutcome): Promise<void>;
}
```

## options

```ts
export type VmSelector = {
    id: string;
    name?: never;
} | {
    name: string;
    id?: never;
};

export interface Registry {
    username?: string;
    password?: string;
    ca_pem?: string;
}

export interface ImageListOptions extends CallOptions {
    refresh?: boolean;
}

export interface ImagePullOptions extends CallOptions {
    registry?: Registry;
}

export interface CreateOptions extends CallOptions {
    name?: string;
    cpus?: number;
    memory?: number;
    env?: Record<string, string>;
    networks?: readonly NetworkInfo[];
    image?: string;
    command?: readonly string[];
    registry?: Registry;
}

/** Managed ownership is always unnamed and ephemeral. */
export type ManagedCreateOptions = Omit<CreateOptions, 'name'> & {
    name?: never;
};

export interface RunOptions extends CallOptions {
    timeout_secs?: number;
    cpus?: number;
    memory?: number;
    env?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface DiagnosticOptions extends CallOptions {
    since?: string;
    limit?: number;
}

export interface TriageOptions extends DiagnosticOptions {
    vm_id?: string;
}

export interface LogOptions extends CallOptions {
    grep?: string;
    tail?: number;
    max_bytes?: number;
}

export interface HostLogOptions extends LogOptions {
    source?: HostLogSource;
}

export interface HistoryOptions extends CallOptions {
    limit?: number;
    offset?: number;
    search?: string;
    layer?: HistoryLayerFilter;
}

export interface TimelineOptions extends CallOptions {
    trace_id?: string;
    since?: string;
    limit?: number;
    layers?: TimelineLayer[];
}

export interface NetworkLogOptions extends CallOptions {
    cursor?: string;
    limit?: number;
    vm?: string;
    connection?: string;
    type?: string;
    decision?: string;
    since?: number;
    until?: number;
}
```

## resources

```ts
export interface VmContext {
    transport: Transport;
    id: string;
}

/** Paths are the guest's: `/root/x` in a VM, `/workspace/x` in its container,
 * or `x` relative to the workspace. `exact` takes a path literally, relative to
 * the workspace root, even when it is absolute. */
export type FileOptions = CallOptions & {
    exact?: boolean;
};

export declare class Files extends Resource {
    read(path: string, options?: FileOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>;
    write(path: string, data: Uint8Array, options?: FileOptions): Promise<models.UploadResponse>;
    /** An empty `path` lists the workspace root. */
    list(path?: string, options?: FileOptions & {
        depth?: number;
    }): Promise<models.FileListResponse>;
}

export declare class Stats extends Resource {
    summary(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.VmStatsSummaryResponse>;
    details(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.VmStatsDetailResponse>;
}

export declare class Container extends Resource {
    status(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.ContainerStatusResponse>;
}

export interface Port {
    id: string;
    guest: number;
    host: number | null;
    authenticate: boolean;
    url?: string;
    /** Non-enumerable: never serialized or printed with the port. */
    readonly bootstrapToken?: string;
    expiresInSeconds?: number;
}

export declare class Ports extends Resource {
    constructor(context: (options: CallOptions) => Promise<VmContext>, target: (options: CallOptions) => Promise<models.ExposureTarget>);
    open(guest: number, options?: CallOptions & {
        host?: number;
        authenticate?: boolean;
    }): Promise<Port>;
    list(options?: CallOptions): Promise<Port[]>;
    close(opened: Port, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.VmActionResponse>;
}

export declare class Networks {
    constructor(transport: Transport);
    create(name: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.NetworkInfo>;
    list(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.NetworkInfo[]>;
    inspect(networkId: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.NetworkInfo>;
    delete(network: models.NetworkInfo, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.VmActionResponse>;
    logs(network: models.NetworkInfo, options?: NetworkLogOptions): Promise<models.NetworkLogsResponse>;
}

export declare class VmNetworks extends Resource {
    list(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.NetworkInfo[]>;
    attach(network: models.NetworkInfo, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.NetworkInfo>;
    detach(network: models.NetworkInfo, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.NetworkInfo>;
}

export declare class McpTools {
    constructor(transport: Transport, serverId: string);
    list(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.McpToolsListResponse>;
    call(name: string, arguments_: models.Value, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.Value>;
}

export declare class McpServer {
    readonly info: models.McpServerInfoResponse;
    readonly tools: McpTools;
    constructor(transport: Transport, info: models.McpServerInfoResponse);
    refresh(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.McpRefreshResponse>;
}

/** The MCP servers every VM runs: settings.toml `[mcp]` with corp's laid over it. */
export declare class Mcp {
    constructor(transport: Transport);
    info(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.McpInfoResponse>;
    servers(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.McpServersListResponse>;
    defaultPermission(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.McpDefaultPermissionResponse>;
    get(name: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<McpServer>;
}
```

## connections

```ts
/** Host consent never implicitly grants a VM access or launches a browser. */
export declare class Connections {
    constructor(transport: Transport);
    list(options?: CallOptions & {
        limit?: number;
        cursor?: string;
    }): Promise<models.ConnectionListResponse>;
    /** Retain the request ID; opening the returned URL and polling are explicit. */
    authorizeGoogle(request: models.AuthorizeGoogleRequest, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.AuthorizeGoogleResponse>;
    authorization(id: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.AuthorizationTransaction>;
    cancelAuthorization(id: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.AuthorizationTransaction>;
    get(id: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.ConnectionSummary>;
    /** Fence grants; poll explicitly to confirm provider retirement. */
    disconnect(id: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.DisconnectResponse>;
}

/** Explicit approvals for the canonical session resolved by this VM handle. */
export declare class CredentialGrants {
    constructor(context: (options: CallOptions) => Promise<VmContext>);
    list(options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.SessionGrantListResponse>;
    /** Never reconnect, acquire consent or replay a mutation implicitly. */
    create(request: models.CreateSessionGrantRequest, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.SessionGrantSummary>;
    revoke(grant_id: string, options?: CallOptions): Promise<models.RevokeSessionGrantResponse>;
}
```

## credentials

```ts
/** Explicit host material; responses contain only opaque references. */
export declare class Credentials {
    constructor(transport: Transport);
    inject(provider: `${CredentialInjectProvider}`, value: string, options?: CallOptions & {
        storage?: `${CredentialStorage}`;
    }): Promise<CredentialInjectResponse>;
}
```

## transport

```ts
export declare enum Method {
    GET = "GET",
    POST = "POST",
    PUT = "PUT",
    DELETE = "DELETE"
}

export declare enum MediaType {
    JSON = "application/json",
    BINARY = "application/octet-stream",
    GZIP = "application/gzip"
}

export interface CallOptions {
    signal?: AbortSignal | undefined;
    /** Replaces the transport's default deadline for this call. */
    timeoutMs?: number | undefined;
}

export interface TransportOptions {
    timeoutMs?: number;
}

export declare class HttpError extends Error {
    readonly status: number;
    readonly body: string;
    readonly name = "HttpError";
    constructor(status: number, body: string);
    /** Future/non-JSON refusal envelopes retain their HTTP status and raw body. */
    get credentialCode(): CredentialErrorCode | undefined;
}

export declare class NetworkError extends Error {
    readonly name = "NetworkError";
    constructor(cause: unknown);
}

export declare class Transport {
    constructor(url: string, token: string, options?: TransportOptions);
    /** The default per-request deadline, in milliseconds. */
    get timeoutMs(): number;
    close(): void;
    request(method: Method, path: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>;
}
```
